@echo off
setlocal
cd /d "%~dp0"
set "PY=D:\OwnNeuralNet\.venv\Scripts\python.exe"
set "OUT=D:\OwnNeuralNet\uno_s4_wm_007_gpu"
if not exist "%PY%" (
 echo ERROR: Python venv missing: %PY%
 goto failed
)
"%PY%" test_007.py
if errorlevel 1 goto failed
"%PY%" -u uno_s4_wm_007.py --device cuda --rungs r2_two,r3_three,r4_overwrite --modes no_memory,s4_goal --steps 200 --batch 32 --eval-samples 512 --log-every 25 --save-every 25 --route-loss 0.25 --key-gain 0.99 --max-seconds 600 --max-temp 80 --max-gpu-mib 7000 --output "%OUT%"
if errorlevel 1 goto failed
echo.
echo SUCCESS. Results: %OUT%
pause
exit /b 0
:failed
echo.
echo STOPPED OR FAILED. Previous output and checkpoints were not deleted.
echo If there is a checkpoint, use RESUME_GPU_007.cmd.
pause
exit /b 1

@echo off
setlocal
cd /d "%~dp0"
set "PY=D:\OwnNeuralNet\.venv\Scripts\python.exe"
set "OUT=D:\OwnNeuralNet\uno_s4_wm_007_gpu"
if not exist "%PY%" goto failed
if not exist "%OUT%" (
 echo ERROR: No previous output. Use START_GPU_007.cmd instead.
 goto failed
)
"%PY%" test_007.py
if errorlevel 1 goto failed
"%PY%" -u uno_s4_wm_007.py --device cuda --rungs r2_two,r3_three,r4_overwrite --modes no_memory,s4_goal --steps 200 --batch 32 --eval-samples 512 --log-every 25 --save-every 25 --route-loss 0.25 --key-gain 0.99 --max-seconds 600 --max-temp 80 --max-gpu-mib 7000 --resume --output "%OUT%"
if errorlevel 1 goto failed
echo.
echo SUCCESS. Results: %OUT%
pause
exit /b 0
:failed
echo.
echo STOPPED OR FAILED. Output was not deleted.
pause
exit /b 1

@echo off
setlocal
cd /d "%~dp0"
set "PY=D:\OwnNeuralNet\.venv\Scripts\python.exe"
if not exist "%PY%" (
 echo Python not found: %PY%
 pause
 exit /b 1
)
"%PY%" test_007.py
pause
